shortlist.title: Accenture Investor Briefing: Driving the Reinvention Ahead
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: market thesis → differentiated capabilities → proof points → operating model implications
visual composition pattern: consistent headline + subhead + quantified callouts, disciplined whitespace, repeatable slide grids
evidence presentation pattern: market sizing + pipeline metrics + case snippets framed as outcomes
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Investor-relations framing can skew optimistic; treat quantified claims as illustrative unless you can corroborate.

shortlist.title: AIM312-S Accenture Public Service (AWS Summit DC 2024) – GenAI governance
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: risk framing → governance pillars → roles/RACI → operating cadence
visual composition pattern: summit-grade templates with strong hierarchy, icon discipline, and modular blocks
evidence presentation pattern: governance recommendations anchored to frameworks and implementation steps
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Conference decks sometimes omit hard numbers; treat as pattern reference rather than evidence source.

shortlist.title: Databricks Reference Architecture (Databricks on AWS)
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: layered platform map with clear domains (ingest → store → govern → serve → consume)
visual composition pattern: component taxonomy that reads cleanly at exec distance
evidence presentation pattern: architecture as evidence—capability coverage demonstrated by mapped services
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Vendor-centric; adapt to neutral language if you want a cloud-agnostic blueprint.

shortlist.title: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework for Artificial Intelligence (CAF for AI)
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: operating model domains + stakeholder alignment + capability roadmap
visual composition pattern: framework-driven slide primitives you can reuse as 'pillars' slides
evidence presentation pattern: credibility via structured practices and cross-links to prescriptive guidance
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: More framework than execution details; pair with a delivery plan deck when building proposals.

shortlist.title: Microsoft – The Art of Practical AI: Transforming Customer Experiences (customer stories deck)
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: customer barrier → AI solution → adoption enablers → outcomes
visual composition pattern: case-study slide rhythm (context, challenge, solution, impact) with consistent scaffolding
evidence presentation pattern: outcome claims presented as business metrics and operational improvements
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Marketing-led storytelling; validate outcome numbers if you reuse as evidence.

shortlist.title: Analysys Mason – AI and Data Platforms: Worldwide Market Shares 2024 (PPTX)
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: market landscape → segmentation → winners/losers → implication slide
visual composition pattern: chart-first storytelling with clean annotation and minimal decoration
evidence presentation pattern: credible third-party analyst charts to anchor executive decisions
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Analyst IP usually has strict reuse terms; treat as internal reference unless licensed.

shortlist.title: ASEAN Guide on AI Governance and Ethics
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: governance principles → national-level recommendations → organizational controls
visual composition pattern: policy-doc sections that can be reframed into deck-friendly pillars
evidence presentation pattern: authoritative guidance as defensible governance baseline
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Policy tone can be heavy; translate into a lighter exec narrative for consulting decks.

shortlist.title: Smartsheet – Project Kickoff Presentation Template (PPTX)
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: scope → approach → phases → roles → reporting
visual composition pattern: straightforward, client-safe layout scaffolding and agenda discipline
evidence presentation pattern: delivery governance presented as timelines and RACI blocks
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Template feel; you will need to elevate typography and visual system to reach McKinsey-level polish.

shortlist.title: Remade Institute – RFP PowerPoint Template (PPTX)
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: compliance sections → technical approach → milestones → team → budget framing
visual composition pattern: proposal template scaffolding with consistent sectioning
evidence presentation pattern: use of structured prompts that force measurable deliverables
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Design may be utilitarian; treat as structural ground truth rather than visual gold standard.

shortlist.title: UNHCR RFP 1007 – Bidders Conference Slide Deck
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: evaluation criteria → submission mechanics → timelines → Q&A norms
visual composition pattern: how procurement decks prioritize clarity and compliance over decoration
evidence presentation pattern: explicit scoring and gates you can mirror in your response deck
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Not visually premium; its value is in procurement structure and compliance patterns.

shortlist.title: Florida PALM – Executive Steering Committee Meeting Presentation (09/27/2023)
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: budget → progress → risks/issues → next steps
visual composition pattern: board-ready tables and spend-plan visuals that stay readable
evidence presentation pattern: financial execution evidence shown with simple, stable reporting artifacts
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Public-sector style can be dense; improve by adding executive synthesis and fewer tables per slide.

shortlist.title: Wildcard: Microsoft 365 Security Compass – Presentation
what_to_learn: story structure pattern: security posture → guiding principles → architecture patterns → operational practices
visual composition pattern: Microsoft-grade hierarchy, iconography, and clean section banners
evidence presentation pattern: mapping guidance to architecture references as credibility anchors
shortlist.risks_or_caveats: Security-specific; adapt patterns to AI governance and data platform context.
